scope.scope: Complete 28-table applicable catalogue, all statuses, purposes and releases; 396 current items and 269 immutable item versions; 66 current template guides, 10 skill guides, 159 runtime and 315 authoring guide versions.

readContinuity.scope: Complete 28-table corpus carried from the same-session coverage audit after every one of the 38 fresh complete-table counts/fingerprints matched. No relevant content changed.

scope.freshInspection: All 30 current S03/S07 questions and their 16 template guides; S03/S07 historical text differences; Chapter I S05 experiment-design questions; nearest S06-M01, S05-I11, S08-I07 and related guides. Prior same-session whole-Chapter-II and related bank readings carried only after all 38 complete-table guards matched.
scope.historyBoundary: Complete histories are frozen, including retired/exposed versions. Current/historical source and guide relationships are retained. A repeated taught claim/procedure is permitted only by the approved pilot; no assertion of independent new reasoning is made.
scope.sourceRead: Textbook §8 printed pp.26–28 and §10 pp.30–33, §11 p.34 freshly checked, plus unchanged Chapter II and Chapter I source evidence from the preceding same-session audit.
scope.relatedMappings: S02/S03 share the particle-structure outcome; S05/S06/S07/S08 address motion, diffusion and temperature. Chapter I S05 experiment reasoning is a prerequisite. All are included; no scope is excluded because its code, family, bank or release differs.
scope.author: Codex automated educational judgment; human content, SME and exposure reviews remain pending.
